Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) And the time loops just kept getting smaller and smaller. And then, using Candace's spoon...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (cont'd) ...we saved the world!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (cont'd) Again! And that's what we did for summer vacation.

Name: Teacher
Dialog: That's a fascinating report, Phineas. We appreciate you breaking it up into nine months of installments for us.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we wanted to be thorough.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And you finished just in time for the end of this school year!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, I can't wait for tomorrow! The official first day of summer vacation!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, but we don't have to wait that long.

Name: Phineas, The Gang & Kids
Dialog: 4... (TICK)

Name: Phineas, The Gang & Kids
Dialog: 3... (TICK)

Name: Phineas, The Gang & Kids
Dialog: 2... (TICK)

Name: Phineas, The Gang & Kids
Dialog: 1... (TICK)

Name: Phineas, The Gang & Kids
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P! I know you've been on venomous insectoid robot duty for the last nine months, but I have good news. Well, news. We suspect that Doofenshmirtz is back to his evil ways. And by "suspect" I mean... he emailed us.

Name: Carl
Dialog: He also updated his social media status to "evil again".

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes, it's all very alarming, Agent P.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Boy, he's fast!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I am ready for summer shenanigans!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, the Start of Summer Block Party is tonight!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, what can we make for it? (gasps) How about the world's biggest bounce house?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: A smile-powered rocket to the moon!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bread Bowl Hot Tub!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: A giant Whack-a-Pest!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: A pop the balloon dart game, but huge!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bread bowl hot tub!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Cotton candy the size of a house!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Bumper cars that fly!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Soupy jacuzzi in a loaf!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bread bowl hot tub!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (smugly) I dunno. Why not build them all?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Great idea, Candace! (They file out the gate one at a time.) Let's do it! Oh, yeah!

Name: Isabella and Baljeet
Dialog: All right!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Let's do it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: And they can't all disappear... Can they? (evil laugh, clears throat)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom, Mom, Mom, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (sighs) You wait so long to hear your baby say the word and then they never stop saying it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb are in the backyard making—

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes. Yes. I asked them to put something together to spice up our booth at the block party. But you can help me bring out the pies.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dumb pies ruin everything.

Name: Linda
Dialog: It seems I spent all of last summer running around while you kids were having fun, and I missed seeing any of it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah. Duh.

Name: Linda
Dialog: I just wanna spend more time together as a family this summer.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: What else can I do, dear?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm really busy, so I need you to man our pie booth at all times. Do not leave under any circumstances.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (salutes) Roger that, darling!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Now you know how every year we take a family photo on the first day of summer? Well, with all the excitement of the block party, I don't want you to forget to show up for the photo.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Those pictures are so corny. Why do we keep doing it?

Name: Linda
Dialog: I just wanna capture these memories because you guys are growing up so fast. (Her eyes well up with tears.) No! No time for waterworks. These pictures always make me cry. I've gotta finish up so I can spend the rest of the day with you kids.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So you're seriously gonna be here for the rest of the day?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (walks away) That's the idea.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! This bust is gonna be as easy as...

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...something... really easy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: There he is! Welcome, Perry the Platypus! I knew my return to evil would be met with an equal opposing force of semiaquaticness.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Can I get ya anything? Lemonade? Veggie dip? A trap?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha! Isn't it great? It's like old times. I... Like I always say, "If you love something, set it free. If it comes back, trap it!". (laughs)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey, Dad. What are you...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Up to no good! Thanks for asking, Vanessa!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, so we're evil again? Hi, Perry. (to her father) I'm meeting up with some friends. Try not to blow yourself up.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm not making any promises.

Name: Candace
Dialog: [cackles] Look at all the bustable things they built!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Anyhoo, on to today's monologue.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold, the vaporizer-inator! I know it's a chicken balloon, but it was on clearance, and it has nothing to do with the scheme. (stammers) Unless... Unless you wanna vaporize chickens for some reason, (pulls Perry onto the balloon) which I am not opposed to. Anyway, the vaporizer-inator, you point, you click, whatever annoys you is gone, vaporized. Because, as you well know, a lot of things annoy me, Perry the Platypus. I'll show you. Cell towers that look like trees? Vaporized! Mannequins with no hands? Vaporized!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The "song of the summer". Who decides it's the song of the summer?! Vaporized! I know, I know, today's inator's a little basic, but I'm purposely starting off slow. You can't just dive back into the deep end of evil without warming up. You'll pull a muscle, Perry the Platypus.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (singsongy) This is the job my wife gave me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Five times the inventions is five times the bust! Nothing could possibly take away all five of these things at once!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's even got an attachment to shoot five things at once. C'mon, Perry the Platypus, there's gotta be something that annoys you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, there's that sass! That's what I've been missing. C'mon, for reals, there's gotta be something you want to vaporize, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! This is it! The start of summer! (pulls her mother's arm) This is gonna be the one!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Are we gonna do this again?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just this once! This is the one!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, look! Just turn your head ninety degrees!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (With her eyes closed, turning head) Candace, it's okay, I—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom...!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: [screaming]
